crew.name: Biscuit
crew.blurb: Hooks out small fish and eats every fourth. Warns of a bite.
crew.desc: The dock cat, signed on for fish. She hooks the small ones out with a paw while the boat lies still, eats every fourth, and stares at the water just before your float goes under.

crew.name: Mister Hollis
crew.blurb: Fishes a hand line after dark or in fog. Thin by day.
crew.desc: A gentleman made of fog, who has waited forty years for the packet boat. After dark, or wherever the fog lies, he fishes a hand line over the side and is very correct about it. By day there is not enough of him to hold one.
